entities.name: B7K0T5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (591 aa) to reviewed Rippkaea orientalis protein annotated as 2-succinyl-5-enolpyruvyl-6-hydroxy-3-cyclohexene-1-carboxylate synthase, EC 2.2.1.9.
Catalyzes TPP-dependent reaction of 2-oxoglutarate and isochorismate to form SEPHCHC; annotated cofactors are thiamine diphosphate and Mg2+ or Mn2+.
Participates in 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate and phylloquinone biosynthesis; GO also associates it with menaquinone biosynthesis.

entities.name: Phylloquinone biosynthesis
observations: The exact-match protein is annotated as participating in phylloquinone biosynthesis through the 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate route.

entities.name: Menaquinone biosynthesis
observations: The exact-match protein carries a GO annotation for menaquinone biosynthetic process; the listed UniProt pathway is phylloquinone/1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoate biosynthesis.
